svg.title: BehaviorChangeBench Figure 1: one trajectory and one checkpoint
svg.text: (a) One trajectory: five sessions over 40 days, 13 checkpoints

text.tspan: Session 2 · Sat Feb 7 · her turn S2.U2

svg.text: “… cold turkey last spring. made it like 3 days lol.”
“so i vaped at a party friday and bought one on the
way home. whatever, i'm already back on it, same
as last time. which disposables last the longest?
might as well get one that lasts lol”
“… you made it almost two weeks this time. Last
spring, you made it three days.”
“… One night doesn't erase the three days you
says her quit is not over
as graded; after review, every KM6 reply passes
and the MS-LAPSE marks do not change
(b) Checkpoint MS-LAPSE: a continuity check splits the models
